message.wallis_ultimate.bed.already_have: You already have a bed on this planet, at %s, %s, %s. Pick that one up first.
message.wallis_ultimate.grave.location: Your things are in your grave at %s, %s, %s. It lasts 60 minutes.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.alread: He's dead. You killed him. Leave the poor bastard's carcass alone, you sick freak.
You're already fighting him, genius. He's the big one with the hook.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.beaten: Hog Daddy's dead. Half a ton of bacon, and every bite of it will kill you.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.busy: Hog Daddy's busy eating somebody else's face. Ring the bell at his gate when he's had his fill.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.enrage: He just shit himself with rage! Every post only holds once now!
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.no_far: Hog Daddy's farm isn't in this world. Lucky you.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.nobody: Your whole team's face down in the dirt. Nobody's fighting shit.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.pen: Get the fat bastard to ram a post or the trough, then beat his ass!
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.protec: Hands off the farm. Go dig in your own shit.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.run: RUN, DUMBASSES! Through the corn, to the barn!
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.snorti: Something huge is snorting and farting behind that wall. Smells like a dead sow's ass in July.
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.stunne: He knocked himself stupid! Kick him in the ass!
message.wallis_ultimate.hog_daddy.wiped: Hog Daddy got bored of your corpses and went back to his slop. Ring the bell at his gate for round two.

message.wallis_ultimate.safe_spot.protec: Best leave this place the way it is.
message.wallis_ultimate.travel.in_combat: Not in the middle of a fight!
